item.mod-stella-spells.spark_shot.effect: Hits the mob for 3 magic damage and sets it on fire for 2 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.frostbind.effect: Chills the mob with Slowness II for 4 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.gale_step.effect: Launches you forward on a gust, then lets you drift down with Slow Falling for 2 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.stoneguard.effect: Hardens your skin with Resistance I for 4 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.static_lash.effec: Shocks the mob for 3 damage, then arcs 3 damage to up to two more hostiles within 4 blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.briar_snare.effec: Roots the mob in thorns with Slowness IV for 4 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.tidal_push.effect: Knocks the mob away from you with a wave.
item.mod-stella-spells.slimebound.effect: Grants Jump Boost II and Slow Falling for 8 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.chainstorm.effect: Calls lightning onto up to 5 hostiles within 5 blocks of the spot you look at, one strike after another, 6 damage each.
item.mod-stella-spells.riftwalk.effect: Teleports you onto the spot you look at, or in front of the wall you look at; never into walls, water or mobs.
item.mod-stella-spells.phoenix_mantle.ef: Grants Fire Resistance for 30 seconds and heals you for 2 hearts.
item.mod-stella-spells.life_bloom.effect: Heals you for 4 hearts and grants Regeneration I for 5 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.void_well.effect: Pulls every hostile within 5 blocks of the spot toward it and slows them with Slowness II for 3 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.wardens_roar.effe: Deals 6 damage to every hostile within 5 blocks of you and throws them back.
item.mod-stella-spells.aegis_of_the_deep: Grants Absorption II and Resistance I for 4 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.wither_seal.effec: Seals the mob with Wither II for 5 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.time_lock.effect: Slows every hostile within 5 blocks of the spot with Slowness II for 5 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.dragonfall.effect: Calls down a dragon strike for 10 magic damage to every hostile within 3 blocks of the spot.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.target.hosti: Target: the hostile mob you look at, up to 16 blocks away
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.target.block: Target: the block you look at, up to 16 blocks away
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.target.safe_: Target: the spot you look at, up to 16 blocks away
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.use.hostile: Use: hold it and right-click while aiming at the mob
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.use.block: Use: hold it and right-click while aiming at the ground
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.use.safe_tel: Use: hold it, look at where you want to stand, and right-click
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.scroll: Single use: the scroll crumbles when the spell lands
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.imbued: Imbued: %s, cast on hit at half strength
item.mod-stella-spells.ice_lance.effect: Hurls a lance of ice through the mob and on for 16 blocks: every hostile on its line takes 5 damage and freezes solid for 7 seconds, and the lance leaves a trail of snow mist.
item.mod-stella-spells.soul_siphon.effec: Drains 4 health from the mob and gives it to you.
item.mod-stella-spells.venom_dart.effect: Stings the mob for 2 damage and poisons it with Poison II for 5 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.sapping_hex.effec: Weakness II on every hostile within 6 blocks, and Strength II on you: 3 seconds for each hostile hexed, up to 15.
item.mod-stella-spells.blinding_flash.ef: Blinds the mob for 5 seconds and makes it glow for 10.
item.mod-stella-spells.ember_brand.effec: Brands the mob for 2 damage and sets it burning for 10 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.quicksilver.effec: Gives you Speed II for 20 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.tide_lungs.effect: Lets you breathe underwater for 60 seconds and swim fast for 20.
item.mod-stella-spells.berserk.effect: Gives you Strength II for 10 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.haste_rune.effect: Gives you Haste II for 60 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.shadow_veil.effec: Makes you invisible for 30 seconds. The first blow you strike breaks the veil: it deals double damage and stops its victim dead for 2 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.sanctuary.effect: Heals you by 6, and every other player within 6 blocks by 4.
item.mod-stella-spells.purify.effect: Clears every harmful effect from you and each player within 6 blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.frost_nova.effect: Deals 3 damage to hostiles within 5 blocks of you and slows them with Slowness IV for 3 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.earthspike.effect: Throws hostiles within 3 blocks of the spot into the air for 4 damage.
item.mod-stella-spells.plague_cloud.effe: Leaves a cloud of Poison at the spot for 5 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.flame_ring.effect: Wreathes you in a burning aura for 10 seconds: each second, hostiles within 3 blocks take 3 damage and catch fire. You never burn.
item.mod-stella-spells.return_scroll.eff: Read it to return to your respawn point in the Overworld.
item.mod-stella-spells.gravity.effect: Hostiles within 6 blocks are slowed and can jump only half as high for 8 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.bulwark_hymn.effe: Absorption II for 20 seconds on you and every ally within 8 blocks: players, villagers, golems and tamed pets.
item.mod-stella-spells.tailwind.effect: Speed II for 30 seconds on you and every ally within 8 blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.battle_hymn.effec: Strength I for 20 seconds on you and every ally within 8 blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.summon_skeleton.e: Raises a skeleton that serves you. Cast again to call it to your side. Use it to open its gear.
